capturePhase: After the frozen source commit, during the normal full pre-push run; not a pre-hook snapshot.
algorithm: SHA256 of sorted UTF8 path + NUL + lowercase file SHA256 + NUL
sourceScope: client/server/shared/scripts/.devcontainer; root code; selected component/native browser inputs
limits: This proves input equality around the normal full check; it does not replace any gate.
